candidates.source_content: The city transport operator announced that the new tram line through the eastern districts will begin carrying passengers on the first Sunday of Advent, 29 November 2026. From that day trams will run every ten minutes between the main station and the new terminus. The operator said the timetable for the new line is published on its website.
